name: Stackcroft Image Studio
author: stackcroft

sections.description:
Stackcroft Image Studio helps you manage and edit WordPress media without sending image content to a third-party processing API.

The Free editor lets you rotate, crop, resize, flip, adjust brightness/contrast/saturation, compare original and edited images, export JPG, PNG and WebP (where supported), and save the result as a new media attachment. The original is preserved. It also offers solid-colour background removal and manual retouch (Eraser/Restore) for cutouts, a mask preview and image audits for large images, missing ALT text and exact duplicate files.

Smart cutout is local colour-based segmentation, not a general-purpose AI object remover. Complex photographs, shadows, transparent objects and fine edges may require manual retouch. Browser-based background removal is limited to 5 megapixels; the editor has additional size limits for safety.

The Free plugin contains no paid processing modules, license-gated features, quotas or time limits. All its included editing and audit features remain available without registration or payment. The separately distributed Pro package (not included in the WordPress.org download) adds batch processing, saved presets, a Campaign Studio for multi-format marketing assets, editable brand templates, and WooCommerce product image workflows. WooCommerce is optional for the basic editor.

External services and privacy

Image Studio includes the Freemius SDK for optional account connection and upgrading to the separately distributed Pro plugin. The optional seven-day trial applies only to this separate Pro package; Free features never expire or require a license. The SDK can connect to Freemius servers to manage those features and, with consent where required, may transmit information about the WordPress installation and site administrator, including the site URL, contact email, technical environment and license status. Free image editing does not require a Freemius purchase. The SDK presents its account and data-sharing choices during onboarding.

Service provider: Freemius, Inc. — https://freemius.com/
Freemius service documentation: https://freemius.com/help/documentation/wordpress-sdk/
Freemius Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
Freemius Terms of Service: https://freemius.com/terms/

Image editing and background removal run in the browser or on the site’s WordPress server. Image files are not transferred to Freemius for image processing. Review these disclosures when preparing your site’s privacy notice.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress choose Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Install Image Studio and activate it.
  3. Open Image Studio in the WordPress admin menu or use its standalone workspace.
  4. Choose an image from Media Library and make a non-destructive edit.
sections.faq:
Does the editor delete originals?

No. The image editor saves a new attachment and retains the source image.

Is the background remover an AI model?

No. It is a local colour-connected cutout with manual retouch and limited product-oriented helpers.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

No, only WooCommerce Studio features require it.

Does this plugin send images to an external API?

No external image-processing API is used by the editor or background cutout.
